source_cache_provenance.historical_base_scope: E17 SDSD-only run identity checked; historical training split SHA not inferred
source_cache_provenance.gt_firewall: GT stored only as source loss labels; restoration and RAFT receive low/prediction only

normalization.source: Fit scenes only; population feature std; uncentered target RMS; mean base MSE

geometry_context: Full256 RGB/flow/address context; only loss is cropped128/eight frames

calibration.interpretation: effective observation-error proxy; not physical camera noise

preparation_runtime.manifest_order: original source order regardless of worker completion

cost_config.unary: HP9(q_target) vs HP9(warp(q_source)), mean SSD / effective variance sum
cost_config.pair: common valid pixel SSD of two warped donors / effective variance sum
cost_config.mask: original valid intersect candidate geometric validity then HP9 support erosion
cost_config.descriptor: cosine distance at patch center sampled using original flow plus candidate offset
